messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Please use the link below to complete your update for our new OWA/outlook improved web mail.', 'Our Maintenance Unit is running a planned Private and Corporate Banking software update', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.', 'Our Technical service Department is carrying out a planned software upgrade for the maximum convenience of the users of online-services of the HSBC internet banking.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Our Technical Division is running a scheduled Personal and Business Banking software upgrade.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'Your E-mail Account needs to be updated with our F-Secure R-HTK4S new(2013) version anti-spam/antivirus/anti-spyware.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
